mapper.select: /* file : MenuMapper.xml, id : getUserMenuList */ SELECT A.* FROM TB_MENU A INNER JOIN TB_MENU_AUTH B ON A.MENU_CD = B.MENU_CD WHERE A.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' AND B.AUTH_CD = #{authCd} ORDER BY A.ORDBY

/* file : MenuMapper.xml, id : getAuthMenuList */ WITH RECURSIVE CTE AS ( SELECT MENU_CD , MENU_NM , UP_MENU_CD , 1 AS LEVEL FROM TB_MENU WHERE UP_MENU_CD = 'TOP' AND DEL_YN = 'N' UNION ALL SELECT M.MENU_CD , M.MENU_NM , M.UP_MENU_CD , 1 + CTE.LEVEL AS LEVEL FROM TB_MENU M INNER JOIN CTE ON M.UP_MENU_CD = CTE.MENU_CD WHERE M.DEL_YN = 'N' ) SELECT A.MENU_CD AS ID , A.MENU_NM AS TEXT , A.UP_MENU_CD AS PARENT_ID , LEVEL , IFNULL(B.INQ_AUTH_YN, 'N') AS VALUE FROM CTE A LEFT OUTER JOIN TB_MENU_AUTH B ON A.MENU_CD = B.MENU_CD AND B.AUTH_CD = #{authCd} AND B.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY A.MENU_CD
mapper.insert: /* file : MenuMapper.xml, id : saveAuthMenu */ INSERT INTO TB_MENU_AUTH ( AUTH_CD , MENU_CD , INQ_AUTH_YN , REG_USER_SEQ , REG_IP) VALUES ( #{authCd} , #{menuCd} , 'Y' , #{loginUserSeq} , #{loginUserIp}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE INQ_AUTH_YN = 'Y' , DEL_YN = 'N' , MDFCN_USER_SEQ = #{loginUserSeq} , MDFCN_DT = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP , MDFCN_IP = #{loginUserIp} , DEL_USER_SEQ = NULL , DEL_DT = NULL , DEL_IP = NULL
mapper.select: /* file : MenuMapper.xml, id : getAuthMenuParent */ SELECT UP_MENU_CD FROM ( SELECT UP_MENU_CD FROM TB_MENU WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND MENU_CD IN ( SELECT MENU_CD FROM TB_MENU_AUTH WHERE DEL_YN = 'N' AND AUTH_CD = #{authCd} ) GROUP BY UP_MENU_CD ) P WHERE UP_MENU_CD != 'TOP'
